svg.title: Khadmat AI — System Architecture
svg.desc: Agentic AI service orchestrator architecture showing user input, intent agent, discovery agent, booking agent, follow-up agent, and Google Antigravity orchestration layer

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the user input layer of Khadmat AI')

sendPrompt('What does the Follow-up Agent do in Khadmat AI?')
sendPrompt('What does the final output of Khadmat AI look like?')
